notes: Channel car (task 2, international routes): a multi-route messaging framework with four adapters - Discord, Slack, Email, Webhook - each with an outbound send path and an inbound path, wired into the mycore service loop and the web console, alongside the existing live Telegram route. (1) New module mycore/channels.py (18th module): transport-injected adapters in the same style as the TG adapter; outbound send and incremental inbound polling (Discord REST messages after=<id>, Slack conversations.history oldest=<ts>, email IMAP UNSEEN with UIDNEXT cursor); cursor state under <state>/channels/<route>.cursor; readiness reported as configured() -> (ok, honest reason) where a failure names the secrets.env slot, never the value; send/poll never raise - a dead route logs one sanitized line and stays silent. (2) Service integration: a channel poll leg next to the evolution and cron legs, throttled by CHANNEL_POLL_SEC=30, single-route failures cannot stop the loop; inbound messages pass an allowlist fail-closed gate (empty allow = all denied, matching the TG allowlist rule) before entering the same command/pipeline path as Telegram, with sessions keyed by route:sender (string keys reuse session/model-override/reset machinery unchanged; the TG typing heartbeat stays integer-only). Cron origin extended to int|str|None with string form route:target, so a job created in a channel chat delivers back through that route and falls back to the existing origin > MYCORE_WD_CHAT > log chain when the route is dead. (3) Console: settings gains a validated channels partition (all-or-nothing, unknown keys/types/ports/non-http URLs rejected); GET /api/channels reports readiness only; POST /api/channels/webhook is the webhook inbound endpoint - Bearer CHANNEL_WEBHOOK_SECRET (slot absent = honest 503 naming the slot, wrong bearer = 401, timing-safe compare, value never echoed), then one agent turn in the web process over an isolated webhook session returning {ok, reply}. (4) Secrets: seven new secrets.env slots (discord/slack tokens, SMTP/IMAP user+pass, webhook secret), zero echo anywhere - logs, exceptions, argv and API responses carry slot names only. Honest boundary: Discord/Slack/email inbound is REST/IMAP polling (no WebSocket client in this stdlib-only codebase), and external provider connectivity is pending credentials - what was verified for real: webhook outbound to a local receiver, webhook inbound with a live model turn over Bearer auth, a full SMTP dialogue against a local sink, plus offline fake-transport coverage for all four routes. Verified gates: mycore 588/588, web smoke 77/77, router 30/30, memory 58/58, setup wizard 80/80, srclint 0, doctor 9 active + 20 SKIP 0F/0W on a clean tree, publish READY(0), run_service --check rc=0, boot status 6 green. E2E ran BEFORE these notes were finalized: tmp/e2e_channels.py 8 checks rc=0 ALL VERIFIED (settings/secrets snapshotted and restored byte-for-byte). Also in this release: the product logo switched to the URL-free mark across site nav/hero and console (favicon included), verified by md5 against the public site; competitive-document facts re-synced (18 modules, ~4.9k LOC by the ast line-count convention, 588 tests).
